scripts.studio:update: node studio/sync.js && npm install && npm run studio

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 2.0.1 (CHAT & NAMES)

Fixes and upgrades for the public server.

- CHAT: pressing T no longer pauses the game. Type away while the world keeps going, and old messages fade instead of sticking on screen.
- YOUR NAME IS YOURS: you pick a name once and JOIN goes straight in after that ("change name" under the button). Nobody else can be on with your name, and it stays yours as long as you play at least once a month.
- ANNOUNCEMENTS: news from the admin stacks at the top of your screen (up to 5), each with a bar showing how long it's up. The bigger ones show on the main menu too.
